title: Owl holding a balloon
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M62 30 Q66 40 64 48" fill="none" stroke="#e8e8ff" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="22" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="22" rx="10" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ff8fa3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="18" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#ffb3c1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M71 34 L72 37 L73 34 Z" fill="#ff8fa3"/>
  
  <!-- Owl body -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="68" rx="22" ry="24" fill="#8b6914"/>
  
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="74" rx="14" ry="15" fill="#d4a843"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="74" rx="14" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#e8c06a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Belly feather lines -->
  <path d="M36 66 Q42 70 48 66" fill="none" stroke="#b8922e" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M35 72 Q42 76 49 72" fill="none" stroke="#b8922e" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M36 78 Q42 82 48 78" fill="none" stroke="#b8922e" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Left wing (raised, holding balloon) -->
  <path d="M22 62 Q14 50 18 40 Q22 34 28 38 Q32 42 30 52 Q28 58 30 64" fill="#7a5a10"/>
  <path d="M22 62 Q14 50 18 40 Q22 34 28 38 Q32 42 30 52 Q28 58 30 64" fill="none" stroke="#a08020" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  
  <!-- Wing feathers -->
  <path d="M20 50 Q24 46 27 50" fill="none" stroke="#5c4208" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M19 56 Q23 52 26 56" fill="none" stroke="#5c4208" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Right wing -->
  <path d="M62 62 Q72 55 70 46 Q68 40 62 44 Q58 48 60 56 Q61 60 60 66" fill="#7a5a10"/>
  <path d="M62 62 Q72 55 70 46 Q68 40 62 44 Q58 48 60 56 Q61 60 60 66" fill="none" stroke="#a08020" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  
  <!-- Right wing feathers -->
  <path d="M66 48 Q63 50 62 54" fill="none" stroke="#5c4208" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 54 Q65 56 64 60" fill="none" stroke="#5c4208" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="42" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#8b6914"/>
  
  <!-- Ear tufts -->
  <path d="M26 32 L22 20 L32 28" fill="#8b6914"/>
  <path d="M26 32 L22 20 L32 28" fill="none" stroke="#a08020" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M58 32 L62 20 L52 28" fill="#8b6914"/>
  <path d="M58 32 L62 20 L52 28" fill="none" stroke="#a08020" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Facial disc -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="12" fill="#d4a843"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="12" fill="#d4a843"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes - white -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="8" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="8" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes - iris -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="5.5" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="5.5" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes - pupil -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="3" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="3" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M40 48 L42 54 L44 48 Z" fill="#ff8800"/>
  <path d="M40 48 L42 54 L44 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ffaa33" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M34 90 L30 95 M34 90 L34 96 M34 90 L38 95" stroke="#ff8800" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 90 L46 95 M50 90 L50 96 M50 90 L54 95" stroke="#ff8800" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
